steps.description: User sees hero section, 4 pillars (Academic, Biometric, Gamification, Entrepreneurship), and CTA buttons. Stats bar shows '110+ Use Cases, 6-23 Ages, 4 AI Pillars, ∞ Growth'.
Role selection screen: Parent/Guardian or Student (13+). Three-step wizard begins: Account info (name, email, password), Family setup with COPPA consent, and launch confirmation.
User provides displayName, email, password (min 12 chars, mixed case). Form validates email format and password strength client-side before proceeding.
Parent enters child name, DOB, selects consent method (Credit Card $0.01 hold or Government ID upload). COPPA banner explains consent requirement for under-13.
Summary screen shows account details, child info, consent method. Doter egg preview appears: 'Meet [Child]'s Doter!'. User clicks 'Launch UDB!'
POST /auth/register or Firebase token exchange. AuthService in services/api/src/auth/auth.service.ts upserts UserMaster/UserRel records. DoterProfile created for child role.
JWT stored, redirect to /dashboard. User role detected: child sees ChildDashboard, parent sees ParentDashboard (apps/web/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx:49-53).
If Doter name is default/empty, prompt user to name their Doter via nameMyDoter mutation. See services/api/src/schema.gql:89 and doter.service.ts.
System auto-assigns onboarding quest: 'Complete Your Profile' or 'Take the Baseline Assessment'. Quests page shows first quest card with XP/coin rewards.
User prompted to fill missing fields (timezone, avatarUrl, accessibilitySettings). Profile completion % shown in sidebar.
Time-based greeting ('Good morning/afternoon/evening'), Doter card (avatar, name, state, level, XP bar), stats grid (sleep, focus, stress, steps) from apps/web/src/components/ChildDashboard.tsx:8-73.
Active quests panel shows in-progress quests with pillar tags, XP/coin rewards, and progress bars. Click 'View all' to go to full quest list.
Goal progress cards show mastery percentage, critical skill gap alerts (e.g., 'Fractions 22%'). Color-coded by pillar.
Recent notifications panel lists unread alerts with blue dot indicator. Sidebar badge shows unread count from Sidebar.tsx:82-84.
6 quick action buttons: Ask AI Tutor, Plan My Week, New Quest, Log Evidence, Log Health, Future Self. Each links to corresponding dashboard route.
Full Doter profile page: evolution state (EGG → BABY → TEEN → ADULT → LEGEND), stat modifiers (energetic/sluggy), coin balance, level history.
Full notification list with mark-as-read, clear-all actions. Notifications for quest completion, level up, messages, safety alerts.
ParentDashboard component (apps/web/src/components/ParentDashboard.tsx) shows all linked children with summary cards (name, Doter level, safety score, active quests).
Family Hub page shows linked parents/children. Can invite additional family members via email. Pending approvals listed.
Safety Score (0-100) per child, message screening reports, flagged content alerts. AI-scan summary of all child communications.
In-app messaging system. Parent can message children directly. All messages AI-scanned for safety threshold (score < 70 triggers alert).
Child-uploaded quest evidence (photos, videos). Parent can review, approve, or request resubmission. COPPA-compliant storage.
Profile settings, notification preferences, subscription management (plan view/upgrade link to Stripe Checkout), child account controls.
View child venture escrow accounts, approve/release funds, transaction history via myLedger query. Stripe Connect escrow for student ventures.
Admin-only route protected by RolesGuard (services/api/src/auth/guards/roles.guard.ts). Shows platform-wide metrics: total users, active tenants, revenue, system health.
List of all tenants/families with status, plan tier, usage metrics. Search, filter, sort by plan type, creation date, activity.
Immutable audit chain viewer. Query auditLog with limit parameter. Tamper-evident hash chain displayed per entry. See AuditLog model in prisma/schema.prisma:68-76.
Revenue reports, MRR/ARR calculations, churn analysis, pending invoices. Plan change interface to override tenant subscription.
Flagged messages, evidence review queue, AI tutor conversation audit. Safety score trends per user/tenant.
Redis cluster status, PostgreSQL connection pool, queue backpressure, AI service latency. Integration with prom-client metrics at services/api/src/shared/metrics.controller.ts.
Toggle feature flags per tenant or globally. Environment configuration management. Scheduled maintenance announcements.
Quest list filtered by pillar (Academic, Biometric, Gamification, Entrepreneurship). Each quest shows title, description, XP/coin rewards, estimated duration, and prerequisites.
Click quest card to view details, then 'Accept Quest'. Quest status changes to IN_PROGRESS. API mutation updates Task model with userId, title, status='IN_PROGRESS'.
Quest detail page shows step-by-step instructions. May include sub-tasks with individual progress tracking. Each step completed updates progress percentage.
For evidence-based quests, child uploads photo/video via addEvidence mutation (schema.gql:77). Evidence stored with type, URL, questId linkage.
Child clicks 'Complete Quest'. If evidence required, parent must approve first. XP and coins awarded via addDoterXP mutation (schema.gql:76).
XP gain may trigger level-up. Doter evolves at thresholds: Egg→Baby (1000 XP), Baby→Teen (5000 XP), Teen→Adult (15000 XP), Adult→Legend (50000 XP). Visual transition with animation.
Quest completion may trigger achievement unlock. Achievements page shows recently earned badges, milestone progress, and rarity tiers.
Goal list shows all active goals with pillar color coding, target/current weight, and mastery percentage. Critical skill gaps highlighted with warning badges.
User clicks 'New Goal', opens form with title, pillar selection (ACADEMIC, BIOMETRIC, GAMIFICATION, ENTREPRENEURSHIP), target value, and optional due date. Calls createGoal mutation.
Progress tracked via goalProgress query. Manual updates or automatic sync from quest completions, biometric logs, and academic assessments.
Dashboard goal progress panel reflects latest data. Parent dashboard shows aggregated goal progress across all children.
When currentWeight >= targetWeight, goal marked COMPLETED. XP and coins awarded. New goal auto-suggested based on skill gap analysis from AI Tutor sessions.
Settings page has 'Subscription' section showing current plan (Free/Pro/Enterprise), usage bars for AI hints, storage, and requests. Quota warning if nearing limits.
Plan comparison table shows Free ($0), Pro ($29/mo), Enterprise ($299/mo). Feature matrix with checkmarks for each tier including AI hints/day, storage, family members, biometric history.
User clicks 'Upgrade to Pro'. Backend creates Stripe Checkout Session (via Stripe SDK ^15.5.0). Session includes price ID, customer email, success/cancel URLs.
User redirected to Stripe hosted checkout page. Enters payment details. On success, Stripe redirects to success URL with session_id.
checkout.session.completed webhook received. Stripe module updates tenant plan in Redis (tenant:{id}:plan). Usage counters reset via keys usage:{tenantId}:* pattern DEL.
Success page shows 'You're now on Pro!' confirmation. Usage bars reflect new limits. Pro-only features (expanded marketplace, AI tutor sessions, biometric history) become accessible.
Settings now show 'Manage Subscription' button linking to Stripe Customer Portal for plan changes, payment method updates, and cancellation.
Settings page shows user profile card: displayName, avatarUrl, email (read-only), timezone, createdAt date. editProfile section with inline editable fields.
User updates displayName or avatarUrl via updateProfile mutation (schema.gql:93). Avatar upload processed, stored, URL returned. Changes reflected immediately in sidebar.
Accessibility settings toggles: dyslexiaMode (font), highContrast, text-to-speech, fontSize selector (small/medium/large). Stored in user.accessibilitySettings JSON field.
Notification preference toggles per category: quest reminders, weekly plan prompts, safety alerts, marketing. Changes saved to user preferences.
Password change option, recent login history, connected accounts. Firebase auth integration for Google SSO linking.
On login page, user clicks forgot password link. Redirected to /auth/forgot-password.
User enters registered email address. Form validates email format. Submit triggers password reset request via Firebase Admin SDK or custom email service.
Success message displayed: 'If an account exists, a reset link has been sent'. No email enumeration — same message for found/not-found emails (security best practice).
User receives password reset email with time-limited link (1 hour expiry). Link contains secure token.
User clicks link → /auth/reset-password?token=xxx. New password form with strength requirements (min 12 chars, mixed case, symbols). Confirm password field.
Password reset successful. User redirected to /auth/login with success toast. New password accepted on next login attempt.
User navigates to weekly plan page. If no plan exists for current week, 'Generate Weekly Plan' CTA appears. Sunday AI ritual described.
Click 'Generate' calls generateWeeklyPlan mutation (schema.gql:83). AI considers skill gaps, calendar events, past performance, biometric data from UUP sync engine.
Generated plan shows 7-day view with assigned quests, study blocks, physical activity, and free time. User can drag-reorder, add custom activities, or regenerate.
Weekly plan synced to calendar view. Color-coded by pillar. myCalendar query (schema.gql:111) with from/to date range.
Throughout the week, plan marks tasks as completed. Progress bar shows % of weekly plan achieved. End-of-week summary compares planned vs actual.
User selects subject (Math, Science, ELA, Social Studies). Click 'Start Session' calls startTutoringSession mutation (schema.gql:92). Session context initialized with student's skill gaps.
User types question or uploads problem image. askTutor mutation (schema.gql:78) sends input + sessionId + subject to AI service.
AI responds with scaffolding questions (never direct answers). SocraticResponse type returns intent + response fields. AI hint counter tracked via billing quota.
Multi-turn conversation maintained within session. Session history preserved for review. Skill gap analysis updated after each session.
User ends session. Summary generated: topics covered, time spent, estimated skill gap improvement. Data synced to UUP.
Health dashboard shows today's metrics: sleep, HRV, stress, focus. Historical charts (7-day for Free, 90-day for Pro, unlimited for Enterprise).
User clicks 'Log Today' opens form. Fields: sleep hours, stress level (1-10), focus rating. Alternatively, data can auto-sync from wearable via API.
logBiometric mutation (schema.gql:85) stores data in BiometricLog model. UUP sync triggered — biometric data affects Doter state (sleep deficit → sluggy modifier).
AI-generated coaching insights from coachingInsight query. Focus peak analysis (focusPeak query) identifies optimal study times based on chronotype.
Doter reflects biometric data: good sleep → energetic modifier, poor sleep → sluggy modifier. Visual indicators on Doter card.
Marketplace shows items for purchase with in-app coins. Categories: avatar accessories, Doter cosmetics, power-ups, learning tools. marketplaceItems query returns items with cost, category, icon.
User clicks 'Buy' on item. myBalance query checked for sufficient coins. LedgerEntry created with transactionType='PURCHASE', status='COMPLETED'. Item applied to user/Doter.
User clicks 'New Venture'. Form: venture name, problem statement, solution, target market, pricing model. createVenture mutation (schema.gql:81).
generateBusinessPlan mutation (schema.gql:82) uses AI to create executive summary, validation notes, and feasibility assessment based on BusinessPlanInput.
If venture involves real money, parent-supervised Stripe Connect escrow account created. releaseFunds mutation (schema.gql:90) releases escrow to student wallet.
myLedger query (schema.gql:116) shows paginated transaction history: purchases, coin earnings, escrow movements, XP rewards.
Future Self page shows narrative story 'A Day in the Life at Age 30' generated by Monte Carlo + Gemini simulation based on current habits and data.
Full narrative displayed with scenario branches. Shows projected outcomes: career path, health metrics, financial status, relationships based on current trajectory.
User adjusts parameters (study more, sleep better, save coins) to see alternative futures. Simulation recalculates and shows visual comparison.
Future self insights can be converted into actionable goals. 'Create Goal from Simulation' button populates goal form with AI-suggested targets.
Inbox with conversation threads. Each thread shows last message, timestamp, unread count. sendMessage mutation (schema.gql:91) with receiverId and content.
User selects conversation or starts new one. Message content AI-scanned in real-time. Safety Score computed — if below 70, parent alerted.
Safety dashboard: per-child safety score gauge, flagged messages list, recent alerts. mySafetyScore query returns AI-scan results.
Parent sets safety thresholds, content filters, message monitoring level. Alert preferences for when safety score drops below threshold.
Shows LMS sync status, RIT scores (math, reading), skill gap analysis by subject. Weekly workload prediction based on upcoming assignments.
mySkillGaps query returns per-subject gap scores. Critical gaps (< 30%) highlighted red. AI recommends quests to address gaps.
After AI tutor session or assessment, updateSkillGap mutation (schema.gql:94) adjusts gap scores. Proficiency tracked over time.
From skill gap card, user clicks 'Tutor Me' to start AI tutor session pre-loaded with the gap subject. Seamless cross-page navigation.
Weekly Plan page shows current week view or 'Generate' CTA if no plan. Sunday AI ritual context explained.
generateWeeklyPlan mutation creates balanced week based on skill gaps, calendar, past performance, biometric data.
Drag-reorder tasks, add custom activities, adjust time blocks. Plan saved to Planner model with weekStart date and JSON data.
Plan synced to calendar with pillar color coding. myCalendar query with from/to range.
Throughout week, plan acts as checklist. End-of-week completion summary.
Family Hub shows all linked family members. myFamily query returns full family tree. Parent sees all children, their Doter states, and activity summaries.
Parent can add spouse/co-parent or additional children. For new child, COPPA consent flow re-triggered.
linkChild mutation (schema.gql:84) takes childId and consentMethod. FamilyLink record created connecting parentId to childId.
Per-child permission settings: quest approval required, spending limits, messaging filters, screen time schedules.
Grid of earned and locked achievements. Rarity tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary. Progress bars for in-progress achievements.
Click achievement card shows unlock criteria, progress details, and unlock date if earned. XP and coin rewards listed.
Earned achievements can be shared to family feed or external (parent-approved). Potential future NFT minting for Legendary achievements.
Doter profile displays achievement count and highest rarity badge. Cosmetic rewards (Doter accessories) from achievements appear on avatar.
Immersive social/exploration space. Child's Doter avatar navigates a virtual world. Gamified environment for peer interaction and discovery.
Themed zones: Learning Commons, Adventure Park, Creator Studio, Social Square. Each zone offers different interaction types.
Age-appropriate social features: friend requests, group quests, shared achievements. All interactions AI-safety moderated.
Joon World activities earn separate in-world currency and cosmetics that sync back to main Doter profile.
